theorem.name: SCIENTIFIC_HYPOTHESIS_FORMATION_IS_COMPOSITION_NOT_A_NEW_PRIMITIVE_BY_DEFAULT
premises: The candidate scientific behavior requires hypothesis/question proposal, feasibility/information ranking, and a discriminating test.

Verified Brain-owned components already cover bounded typed template synthesis, exhaustive typed candidate instantiation, finite discriminator selection, exact information-gain/expected-utility arithmetic for explicit models, and explicit research action/stop selection.
The shared semantic basis already classifies unresolved S0/G0/S1 behavior as latent diagnostic/proof-only classes rather than authorized new implementation lanes.
Knowledge and retrievable domain schemas remain JIT by terminal mission law, so a retrievable scientific schema is not a new capability primitive.
theorem.conclusion: Do not create a standalone scientific-hypothesis-generation mechanism lane or an independent whole-leaf comparator program by default. Represent the behavior as a composition acceptance obligation in the existing T3 research portfolio, reusing owned bounded components and measuring only the exact surviving S0/G0/S1 residue if the composed route fails.
theorem.scope_limit: This is a scheduling/proof-basis reduction, not proof that Brain matches Opus 5.5 on open-ended scientific hypothesis formation.
